# Architecture Compliance & Workflow Governance Checklist: Cross-Repository Architecture & Claude Code Review Compliance Tracking

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, clarity, completeness, and edge-case coverage across the Architecture Registry, Dashboard UI, and Cross-Repository Claude Code Review workflows.
**Created**: 2026-10-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all 5 live `AntaresAndBharani` repositories (`crosstrainingapp`, `retro-fighter`, `darwin-trader`, `gh-development-dashboard`, `kerberito`) explicitly enumerated with their technology stacks in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact required workflow file paths (`.github/workflows/claude.yml`, `.github/workflows/pr-review.yml`, `.github/workflows/prompts/pr-review.md`) specified for the `claude-code-review` standard? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are both storage locations for the Architecture Registry (`architecture-registry.json` at repository root and `app/src/main/assets/architecture-registry.json`) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity & State Determinism

- [x] CHK004 Are the rules distinguishing `UP_TO_DATE`, `OUTDATED`, and `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` unambiguously defined without overlapping conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Is the distinction between an explicit HTTP 404 (missing workflow file) and a transient network/rate-limit error clearly specified for compliance evaluation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are the UI requirements for both the expandable "Architecture & Way of Working Compliance" dashboard card and the per-repository `ProjectCard` compliance badge explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]

## Cross-Repository Consistency & Governance

- [x] CHK007 Are the CI workflow naming and commit-SHA polling requirements (`CI_WORKFLOW_NAME: "CI"` and `--commit "$CURRENT_SHA"`) consistent across `gh-development-dashboard` and `kerberito`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Are the self-healing pipeline label requirements (`review:approved`, `review:changes-requested`, `needs-refactor`, `status:needs-po-input`, `status:ready`, `status:done`, `dev-implemented`, `tech-debt`) consistent with `crosstrainingapp` and `retro-fighter`? [Consistency, Spec §US-3]
- [x] CHK009 Is the replacement of legacy `.github/workflows/merge.yml` by `.github/workflows/pr-review.yml` in `gh-development-dashboard` explicitly documented to avoid duplicate merge triggers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for evaluating a newly added repository that is not present in the bundled Architecture Registry? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements defined for idempotent startup seeding when the local `projects` table is empty vs already populated? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are measurable, verifiable success criteria defined for both `gh-development-dashboard` and `kerberito` test suites? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-004]

## Notes

- All 12 requirements-quality items (`CHK001`–`CHK012`) audited against `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/` and verified satisfied on 2026-10-24.
